text:
maria: Heads-up — HW partner asked if we can allow a remote witness for their pen test next month and wants clarity on evidence retention windows. Can we confirm policy?

Tim: We can do remote witnessing but need to lock down chain-of-custody and presigned link TTLs. Suggest 72h for partner upload, then move artifacts to long-term encrypted bucket.

Jordan: +1. Also need a signed attestation from partner for any PII redactions and a contact for incident follow-up. Timeline: witness window 30–60 mins, recordings stored for 90 days by default.

maria: Who owns generating presigned URLs and verifying upload integrity? Partnership or Ops?

samir: Ops should generate presigns with limited scope. We can provide a small script and a temporary role. Example: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-sec-temp/partner-uploads/test-evidence.zip --expires-in 259200
```
(259200 = 72h)

maria: Perfect. Can we also include an md5 hash check and a checklist for what artifacts we accept? (SOC2 report, pen test report PDF, raw vuln scan CSV, redaction manifest)

Tim: Checklist (short):
- Signed NDA + attestation from partner
- SOC2 summary (AOC) or equivalent
- Full pen-test report (PDF) + findings CSV if available
- Raw nmap/nikto/semgrep scan outputs if produced
- Redaction manifest listing removed items and reason
- Evidence owner email and SLA for follow-up

Jordan: Add: naming convention: partnername-YYYYMMDD-project-evidence.zip and a manifest.json inside with hashes and contact info. We should also require S3 server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and bucket-level access logging.

maria: I'll draft the partner-facing doc and include: presign generation, sample CLI, TTL expectations, redaction guidance, and retention windows (72h presign upload -> 90 days recordings -> 365 days archived for SOC artifacts).

samir: For archive retention we need legal sign-off for >365. For now enforce 365 for SOC/pen PDFs; other raw outputs -> 90 days then delete.

Tim: Also include an incident escalation matrix: if high/critical vuln found, 24h notify internal security + partner call within 48h.

maria: Great. Action items:
- maria: draft partner doc & publish link <https://redwood.internal/marketplace/pen-witnessing> by Tue EOD
- samir: prepare presign role + sample script and set bucket SSE-KMS by Mon
- tim: add escalation matrix and retention policy to doc
- jordan: draft filename/manifest template and sample manifest.json

jordan: I'll ping legal for >365 retention ask if we need exception.

devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance on the sec-buckets is planned 2024-05-10 02:00-03:00 UTC — presign generation will be blocked during window.

maria: Thanks all — will post draft and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
